pr_metadata.title: fix(plugins): update only the declared marketplaces and report a failed command's stdout
pr_metadata.summary: The shared marketplace refresh now runs 'claude plugin marketplace update <name>' for each marketplace it adds, so a stale undeclared marketplace can no longer fail vrg-host plugins or vrg-vm update, and a failed command's stdout (where claude writes some causes) is now printed with its failure.
pr_metadata.notes: Agentic review: pass after 1 round (0 Critical, 0 Important, 2 Suggestions). R1.2 fixed: docs and docstrings now name the derived claude-plugins-official marketplace in the update step. R1.1 not fixed in code: by ruling, undeclared marketplaces are not touched, so a plugin enabled from one is updated from that marketplace's catalog as it stands; documented on the branch, and follow-up vergil-project/.github#801 checks whether that leaves it stale. A failed add or update is labelled marketplace:<name> (the old 'marketplace update' label is gone). Stdout is printed by _report (the Run still echoes stderr), which also covers the two list --json commands. Each update prints a new 'updating marketplace <name>...' progress line. Security: 0 found. No commits after the reviewed HEAD other than the R1.2 docs fix (9248c11, unreviewed).
